decisions.reason: The FAQ already has a complete same-message MODIFY updating its Small and Big Block prize explanation to the new winner counts and sales intervals.
The Mission page already has a complete same-message MODIFY updating its prize-pool copy to the revised Small and Big Block parameters.
Changing prize winner counts and draw intervals does not determine whether prizes are transferred automatically or collected through a manual claim flow.
The source changes prize quantities and draw frequency but leaves ticket weighting, eligibility, random selection, and Chainlink VRF unchanged.
A same-message MODIFY already records one winner, a $10,000 pool per draw, and a draw every 10,000 sales; the unchanged $10,000 per-winner amount remains valid.
More frequent draws shorten the practical ticket window but do not change the stated lifecycle rule: tickets remain eligible until their applicable draw and reset afterward.
The source does not change the no-referral trigger, random recipient, commission, or award of one Small and one Big Block ticket.
A same-message MODIFY already records one $500 winner, a $500 pool per draw, and a draw every 100 sales.
The source changes prize cadence but does not remove or alter Aave as the yield provider or the requirement that prize-pool deposits earn yield.
The source explicitly preserves the same net giveaway amount and does not change mint price, founder allocation, referral commission, or the destination of residual proceeds.
Both Small and Big Block mechanisms and their ticket counters remain in use; only prize winner counts and draw intervals change.
The revised prize cadence does not change the flat royalty, founder share, royalty visibility, prize-pool destinations, or the rule that secondary sales do not create referral tickets.
